workarounds.note: 1.4.1 does not level a closing page that follows a page taken whole by a float (here the turned chart on page 3; a page-tall figure that is not turned does the same): without a break, every paragraph of page 4 fills its left-hand column and only the colophon, which no longer fits there, starts the right-hand one; a :::columnbreak before 'About this sheet' splits the closing text by hand in both editions. Move it when the text changes
a table style has no zebra option, so gazetteer() fills every other body row cell by cell with setCellBackground and a palette-linked colour

a no-break space still breaks a caption note (with U+00A0 the English key of Map 3 breaks between '3' and 'harbour office'), so each entry of the key is a bare 'key' chip that keeps its number, its name and the dot after it on one line

the text is ragged, and 1.4.1 has no runt control for ragged text: the last line of every paragraph was read in both editions and reworded until it held more than one word, and three Spanish lines that ended on 'y' were reworded
the colophon is set upright: 1.4.1 paints italic runs in a paragraph style with bodyText.italicColor, so an italic colophon printed in ink instead of the style's muted grey
the gazetteer's table type comes from defaultResourceTypes(LANG), Tabla in Spanish; the map type is named in the pen for both languages
the H1 page break is restated in headings.levels[0].breakBefore
col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, and referenceColor is restated: 1.4.1 paints the opener's band, kicker, title and lead, the running heads and the reference colour from the hex
design text lineHeight is given as a multiple
every frontmatter value is quoted: the title feeds the opener's large name and the verso running head
